statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-116303 (PostgreSQL foreign key and JSON conversions bypass EXECUTE privilege on cast functions) is fixed upstream in PostgreSQL 16.16: https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-116303/ and the 16.16 release notes, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/16.16/. The CVE record, https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-116303, lists 16 as affected before 16.16. Alpine's postgresql16 16.16-r0 on the 3.23-stable branch is the upgrade to 16.16 and lists CVE-2026-116303 under 16.16-r0 in its secfixes: https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/859fa0795e895af033fab32094a83301f2b4d8ff/community/postgresql16/APKBUILD. The DHI postgresql16 16.16-r0 package for Alpine 3.23 is built from that APKBUILD and the upstream 16.16 source release, and its postgres server binary reports PostgreSQL 16.16 on both x86_64 and aarch64. Every earlier published build for Alpine 3.23 (16.13-r0, 16.14-r0 and 16.15-r0) is an upstream release before 16.16, and its postgres binary reports that older version, so it is affected; 16.16-r0 and later carry the fix.

PostgreSQL fixed CVE-2026-116303, a missing authorization check that lets a database user invoke a cast function without EXECUTE privilege on it, via foreign keys, to_json() and similar conversions, in 17.12 (https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-116303/, https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-116303, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/17.12/). Earlier 17 releases are affected. The server binary in this owner's 17.12-0 build and in its rebuild of Debian's 17.12-0+deb13u1 reports PostgreSQL 17.12 on amd64 and arm64, so both carry the fix. The 17.11-1 build and the current rebuild of Debian's 17.11-0+deb13u1 report PostgreSQL 17.11, and the earlier rebuilds of Debian's 17.10-0+deb13u1 and 17.11-0+deb13u1, no longer in the repository, package PostgreSQL 17.10 and 17.11. All of these are affected and sort below 17.12-0.
